name: Bits And Pieces
description: You are given an array $$$a$$$ of $$$n$$$ integers. You need to find the maximum value of $$$a_{i} | ( a_{j} \& a_{k} )$$$ over all triplets $$$(i,j,k)$$$ such that $$$i \lt j \lt k$$$. Here $$$\&$$$ denotes the bitwise AND operation , and $$$|$$$ denotes the bitwise OR operation .
input_specification: The first line of input contains the integer $$$n$$$ ($$$3 \le n \le 10^{6}$$$), the size of the array $$$a$$$. Next line contains $$$n$$$ space separated integers $$$a_1$$$, $$$a_2$$$, ..., $$$a_n$$$ ($$$0 \le a_{i} \le 2 \cdot 10^{6}$$$), representing the elements of the array $$$a$$$.
output_specification: Output a single integer, the maximum value of the expression given in the statement.
approach_summary: Define state dp[mask][i] capturing the subset of visited/chosen elements. Transition by iterating over valid unset bits in O(2^N × N) time.
